method: Read-only visit on 2026-10-30 to the public Kaggle profile and Competitions pages in the Claude app's built-in browser (one tab, two page loads about 11 seconds apart, no block, captcha or rate limit shown). Text read from the page; the competition card and avatar were checked in a screenshot and by inspecting the page's own avatar element and join-date tooltip. Nothing in any older draft was reused (no earlier evidence file existed for this person). The two non-Kaggle pages cited in the facts (Mainz Visual Computing people page and the Frontiers paper page) were fetched once each with a plain read-only HTTP request on the same day to confirm the wording.

profile.tierNote: Neither the About page nor the Competitions page shows a tier name, a medal count or a competition rank for this account, so none is recorded. Do not infer a tier.

visibleCompetitionList.scopeNote: The public Competitions page lists only one competition, the active ARC Prize 2026 - ARC-AGI-3 (shown as 3 days to go), and no completed competition. That is what the page displays, not proof that the account has no other history. Do not invent finishes.

activeCompetitions.status: Listed as active, '3 days to go' at the time of the check. No final result exists. The card shows four small profile pictures for the entry; no team name is shown on the profile page.

portrait.note: The profile picture on both Kaggle pages is an uploaded, individual picture (not Kaggle's default avatar and not a group image): a cartoon-style brown mouse in dark sunglasses and a cream collared shirt on a blue, green and orange grid. It is a stylised avatar he chose, not a photograph. The page's own avatar element points at https://storage.googleapis.com/kaggle-avatars/images/667711-kg.png (version stamp 2026-10-26-20-36-47, 400 by 400 pixels, sha256 0b0e18a19c571252ba5a69dfefffaca86fb3ba8116bd286c188fd5a492501b5e). The saved file client/public/news-images/people/sebastian-brodehl.webp (320 by 320, saved 2026-10-27, after that version stamp) was viewed beside the original and is the same picture at the smaller size, so it is kept and no -v2 file was made.

teamNotes: Kaggle's own pages show no team name for this entry. The name The ARChitects (team id 16032816) comes only from the newsroom's dated roster evidence at arc.markbarney.net (first seen 2026-10-26, last seen 2026-10-29), which was not re-read in this check. Corroboration seen today: the entry card on his Competitions page shows four profile pictures, and two of them (versions 1739702 and 27819645) match the saved own-profile pictures of Daniel Franzen and David Hartmann in their evidence files; the fourth was not matched to a saved file. His Kaggle page shows no medal or placement, so no team medal or standing is credited to him. Any public ARC-AGI-3 leaderboard position for the team is provisional until the private leaderboard settles at the competition close.
unverified: Tier, medal counts and competition rank: none displayed on his About or Competitions page, so none recorded.
Any completed Kaggle competition or finish: none displayed; the profile page does not show whether he competed under other accounts or before the visible list.
Team name The ARChitects and the roster dates: taken from the newsroom's roster evidence, not shown on his Kaggle pages in this check.

That the Kaggle account sbrodehl and the Mainz alumnus Dr. Sebastian Brodehl are the same person: the Kaggle profile shows no affiliation or link to Mainz, so this rests on the shared name and the dated roster, not on anything printed on the Kaggle page.
Year or details of his Mainz PhD: the alumni page gives only 'former PhD student'.
Any public ARC-AGI-3 leaderboard standing: not checked here and provisional until the private leaderboard at the close.
